name: TPS62160
description: 17 V, 1 A synchronous buck in a 2×2 mm WSON with power-good and 17 µA quiescent current, for small 3.3 V logic rails from 5–12 V.
notes: DCS-Control at ~2.25 MHz: 2.2 µH inductor, small ceramics.
17 V max: 12 V rails and up to 3S LiPo only.
Fixed-output versions exist (TPS62162 = 3.3 V, TPS62163 = 5 V).

en.note: Abs max is VIN + 0.3 V (VIN abs max 20 V), so EN can tie straight to VIN. The typical app (Fig. 7) does this. Logic input: high >= 0.9 V (0.6 V typ), low <= 0.3 V. Internal ~400 kΩ pull-down is connected while EN is low. Leakage 0.01 µA typ. No internal pull-up, so do not float.

pg.note: Open drain. Pull up to any voltage < 7 V (typical app: 100k R3 to VOUT). Sinks 2 mA at spec low level, 10 mA abs max sink. High-Z when off (EN low, UVLO, thermal shutdown). Rising threshold 95% VOUT, falling 90%. If unused, connect to GND or leave floating.

notes: DCS-Control, internally compensated. Nominal 2.25 MHz in PWM; the frequency varies with VIN/VOUT/L. PSM at light load (enters when IOUT < dIL/2).

R1 (top) = R2 x (VOUT/0.8 V - 1) (Eq. 6). Divider current must be >= 2 µA, so R2 <= 400 kΩ. Lower values give the best accuracy/robustness. TI's adjustable examples µse R2 = 150-200k (Figs 38-40) and 180k (Fig 36). If FB opens, VOS is clamped near 7.4 V.
Internal 25 pF feed-forward cap VOS-FB: fzero = 1/(2 pi R1 25 pF), fpole = 1/(2 pi 25 pF) x (1/R1 + 1/R2). External CFF is optional (not in the typical app).

Proven LC combos (Table 2, nominal values): 2.2 µH with 10/22/47/100/200 µF; 3.3 µH with 10/22/47/100 µF. Standard: 2.2 µH + 22 µF. Min inductor 2.2 µH; µse 3.3 µH at low VIN to get full output current. Output cap X5R/X7R ceramic.

Inductor peak: IL(max) = IOUT(max) + dIL/2, where dIL = VOUT x (1 - VOUT/VIN(max)) / (L(min) x fSW) (Eq. 7-8). Add ~20% margin to the saturation rating. Dynamic HS peak = ILIMF + (VIN - VOUT) x 30 ns / L.
ILIMF (HS static current limit) is 1.45/1.95/2.45 A min/typ/max. Low-side limit ~1.2 A typ.
Fixed on-time in PSM ~ VOUT/VIN x 420 ns, with an absolute minimum ~80 ns (approximate, not in the EC table). 100% duty mode: VIN(min) = VOUT + IOUT x (RDS(on) + RL).
Input 10 µF ceramic (typical app: 10 µF 25 V 0805), placed between VIN and PGND. Output 22 µF 6.3 V 0805.
Internal soft start: ~50 µs delay, then VOUT rises at ~25 mV/us. No SS pin.
Fixed-voltage siblings TPS62161/2/3 (1.8/3.3/5 V) share the pinout; on those, FB goes to AGND.
Layout: single-point ground at the thermal pad. FB/VOS traces short and away from SW.
